verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state you can 'build custom integrations that appear and operate inside the Productboard UI' (docs-7) and describe an API/webhooks platform for extending Productboard (intdir-10, docs-5, docs-31), which supports the core claim. However, there's no detail on an actual UI-extension SDK, embed points, or hands-on/independent confirmation of what such an in-UI integration looks like in practice. Missing for 10: concrete UI-extension developer docs/SDK, third-party example integrations that embed in the Productboard UI, and independent corroboration beyond vendor marketing copy.
